tasks.title: Waiting retries release the channel for later ready notifications
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, Behavior R1; Acceptance evidence 1 and its controls; retry ordering documentation and applicable Counterexamples. Keep this task independent of recipient progress and storage migration.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail in the selected tests (the focused run may fail the global coverage threshold). With A's timer held, B is delivered, A is pending with exactly 1 attempt; releasing the timer runs A's attempt 2 without resending B. Cover unlimited retries, independent attempt limits, duplicate waiting keys, FIFO ready ordering B,C,A, one send in flight, stale reminders after waiting, and stop with 2 unresolved timers releasing each key exactly once. Rewrite the existing FIFO test to the new policy. Record the regression's failing assertion on main 3a0b4c8 and passing branch run as required by Acceptance evidence 1.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with line coverage >= 0.8. Retry defaults, delay formula, permanent failure handling, final outcome counts and durable pending claims remain covered.
